subject.title: [Feature]: Slim the Skill Workshop system-prompt section; move mechanics into the tool schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed Skill Workshop prompt/schema split and softer routing wording while keeping the mandatory proposal-first write path?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety and product tone rather than repairing a broken runtime contract, the issue carries the protected `maintainer` label, and the open candidate PR is already marked as needing proof/maintainer decision.

options.title: Approve slim split after proof
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR once it includes real prompt/schema output or transcript evidence showing the slimmer text and preserved `skill_workshop` routing contract.

options.title: Tighten wording first
options.body: Ask the PR to keep one extra explicit lifecycle-write sentence if maintainers want stronger redundancy around apply/reject/quarantine actions.

options.title: Keep verbose guardrails
options.body: Leave the current prompt unchanged if maintainers prefer repeated model-facing prohibitions over lower recurring prompt cost and softer tone.

recommendation.title: Approve slim split after proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR once it includes real prompt/schema output or transcript evidence showing the slimmer text and preserved `skill_workshop` routing contract.
